status: PRELIMINARY ANALYSIS; no character schema or repository port claimed
findings: TGLOBAL.TCreateChar checks the name across TALLCHARTABLE without filtering bDelete; current C++ world-only name check is narrower.
TGLOBAL.TCreateChar permits a reserved name when its dwUserID matches the creator; current C++ rejects any reserved match.

TGLOBAL.TCreateChar writes a global directory row in its own named transaction and returns count of non-deleted account characters; slot/count return semantics must be compared with original handler before changing ACKs.
Current SociCharService::Create performs world writes and the global directory insert on separate pool leases without a shared transaction; failed later writes can leave partial state.

Backed-up TSaveCharDataStart clears temporary inventories/items/skills then calls TGLOBAL_GSP.DBO.TSaveDuringItemStart. TSaveCharDataEnd replaces selected durable tables from temporaries then calls TSaveDuringItem; several item/skill statements are commented out.
External database procedure dependencies and the precise save batch lifecycle need explicit contracts; copying all commented SQL into new runtime behavior would be incorrect.
Migration 008 only provides minimal global lobby projections; character service is unavailable without a configured world repository. Extend via migration 009 or later, never edit 008.
next_checks: Compare backed-up TGAME.TCreateChar and original Login/Map callers, including starting chart data and item allocator.
Choose one native transaction boundary for global index and per-world writes before enabling mutable character operations.
Derive global name/slot uniqueness and soft-delete retention from original consumers; test concurrent creation and injected failures.
